inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: An air conditioner unit had dust accumulation on the vent and dead ants around the unit, dead roaches were on the floor of the children's bathroom, and a door was unlocked to a classroom being used as a storage area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Medication was stored for a child enrolled at the operation and was expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During the investigation process, it was determined that a caregiver pulled child's arm and hair.     *Dir addressed the situation as soon as it was brought to their attention and terminated the caregiver. *
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: A caregiver made sarcastic comments when a child returned to the operation.     *Director addressed the situation when it was brought to their attention and terminated the caregiver. *
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon information gathered as a result of this investigation, documentation, video footage and interviews conducted as it was determined a child was found in classroom #4 unsupervised as the child went through the double doors from classroom #3.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of the ten children were missing shots at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: One of the ten children files was missing contact information for their emergency care or physician.     NOTE: Corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Not After Expiration date: Two children's medication of Albuterol were inspected to have expired on 5/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Not After Expiration date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Nine fire extinguishers in the building were last serviced in June 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon information gathered, surveillance and interviews conducted supervision was determined to have occurred when a child walked out of their classroom down the hallway towards classroom #5 unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: A two-month-old infant was observed in the bouncer as a blanket was used to prop the bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on the information gathered, observation and interviews conducted by the staff, parents, and children. It was determined a caregiver acted inappropriately when pinching a child on the arm as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees who ceased employment in 2023 by the required date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Documentation for severe weather and lockdown drills were not written in the emergency plan Form 7263.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) annual certificate was unavailable for review.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of the ten children didn't have a current immunization record.    Three of the ten children files were missing special care information.     One of the ten children files was missing address to emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One of the ten children files was missing authorization information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Appropriate to Child's Level of Understanding: Based on the information gathered by the caregivers who witnessed another caregiver swapping a child on the hand.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Appropriate to Child's Level of Understanding (26 TAC §746.2803(2))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Appropriate to Child's Level of Understanding: Based on the information gathered, and interviews conducted an employee did not demonstrate an appropriate child?s level of understanding by not expressing proper redirection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Appropriate to Child's Level of Understanding (26 TAC §746.2803(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: Two of the ten staff did not have required trainings in the following;  Administrated medication  Handling and storing  Food allergies
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One of the ten children files was missing emergency medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: Two children from the infant classroom were missing feeding schedules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Two of the ten staff did not have current First aid and CPR available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon information gathered, surveillance and interviews conducted supervision was determined to have occurred when a child was seen walking out of their classroom down the hallway and up the stairs unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: Based on the information gathered, photos and interviews conducted at the time of the inspection no daily schedules were available for review for the infants 0-17 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: Based on the information gathered, photos and interviews conducted at the time of the inspection no feeding schedules were available for review for the infants on bottles.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Based on the information gathered, photos and interviews conducted at the time of the inspection infant bottles are not consistently being labeled.     NOTE: Corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Operation failed to notify Licensing timely of a child in care who sought medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: Liability insurance was not available for review or updated on the portal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Nine of the ten children files were missing Emergency contact  addresses..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Duration: The operational policy did not specify the duration of physical activity, and a plan as to where physical activity is being held during extreme weather conditions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Duration (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(B))
